pure-announcement.rationale: This is Thoughtworks' editorial assessment of 41 software delivery techniques, which is coverage of durable practices rather than any product launch or release note.

duplicate.rationale: Individual blips brush against existing concepts (Agent Skills format, context layer), but the bulk of the 41 techniques — mutation testing, feedback sensors, semantic layer, MCP-by-default caution — is not substantively covered by any nearest concept.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Each blip links primary sources (papers, tool docs, named frameworks) and grounds claims in Thoughtworks' stated project experience, all checkable.

durability.rationale: The blips describe mechanisms and trade-offs — mutation testing versus coverage, progressive context disclosure, sandboxing as default, the MCP abstraction tax — that remain useful well beyond this edition's ring placements.

actionability.rationale: Every technique carries explicit adopt/trial/assess/caution guidance with named tools and failure modes, directly changing what a team would pick up or avoid.

atomicity.rationale: The note bundles 41 separable techniques spanning authentication, testing, data architecture and agent engineering, each of which could stand alone as its own concept — this is a compendium that must be split.
